study: Capsule Review — source-verified acquisition of blood-negative-annotated Galar fitting examinations 22 and 24
status: Frozen before acquiring new source pixels. Training-source acquisition, not a newly fitted model or an independent/clinical evaluation.
scientific_question: Can the original Galar source archive yield two more full-examination-separated 512-image fitting candidates with blood=0 annotations, using previously verified source-block boundaries and the preexisting label-blind fitting/reference source plan?
reserved_examinations: Future Galar 11–20 and source authors' 61–80 are forbidden. Also do not decode or score other Galar fitting exams from shared solid blocks.

official_corrected_annotations.reader: Existing scripts/plan_galar_fitting_images.py exclusively parses allowed 21–30 corrected CSVs, not any protected members.

selection_and_privacy.sampling: Use the pre-existing frozen Galar 21–30 selection plan with 512 label-blind source-chronological midpoint positions per exam. Since all explicit blood labels in 22 and 24 are zero, the fitting-enriched selection is identical to the reference selection. No outcome-conditioned source positions.
selection_and_privacy.output: One private original-PNG ZIP with images/022/ and images/024/ and a private per-image SHA-256 + source-frame + annotation provenance manifest; plus public aggregate-only receipts.
selection_and_privacy.strict_source: Verify actual 7z member names and source block assignment before any multi-GB transfer; 206 exact range/length, SHA-256 of each full block, 7z CRC, original PNG format and every individual image SHA-256, copy only exact allowlisted archive paths. Delete each compressed block before transferring the next.
selection_and_privacy.output_location: Private Capsule Review Library, not Git. GitHub Actions artifact retention 30 days is transient only.
selection_and_privacy.blood_zero_not_healthy: Only absence of explicit blood=1 annotation in corrected source; not absence of all pathology.

post_acquisition_decision: Preserve source images for future training-only examination-separated comparison, with prespecified evaluation and no inclusion of these same examination images in their heldout model-fitting folds. Do not promote a model or claim improved generalization from source acquisition alone.
